name: ondera-agro-mesh
description: Offline-First Edge Multi-Agent Mesh for Ondera Smallholder Coffee Farmers

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "POSTGRES,BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:db" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && (python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 || uvicorn main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000)
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix frontend install && cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt
